scope: Pinned single-feature After Effects colour fixtures authored natively through headless-adobe run_jsx (AE 26.5x89), except color_ae_apply_color_lut and color_ae_lumetri_custom_lut, which were human-authored in the AE 26.5 UI; references are headless-adobe render_aep (aerender, 30 fps) H.264. Structural/decision evidence only; no converter fidelity claim. References are not committed (local evidence only; no in-repo test consumes them): their hashes and authoring records are kept here. AEP bytes are as saved natively except the footage alias path recorded under source.path_sanitization. Exception: color_ae_curves was human-authored in the AE 26.5 UI (no script can set a Curves curve).
licence: Fixtures and references were authored in-house by the committed script color_ae_author.jsx from the repository's own a1_bg_chart.png chart; no third-party project or media is included. color_ae_rec2100_pq_project.aep embeds the Adobe 'Rec.2100 PQ' ICC profile that After Effects writes for its built-in working space; the converter binds it by SHA-256 only (e333f8242594ac5c29a9b68ca9b934baa5e06662b4882ee0fae02564ef10bee0, the same profile payload is already embedded in committed fixtures such as layers/track_matte_yes.aep) and the converter never writes it. color_ae_curves.aep was authored by hand in After Effects from the same chart image. color_ae_lumetri_custom_lut.aep was authored by hand in After Effects from the same chart image and the repository's in-house color_warm_tint.cube.
personal_metadata_review: Reviewed: the only host-specific content was the absolute footage path inside each footage alias 'fullpath' JSON string (five fixtures), replaced as recorded under source.path_sanitization. XMP packets carry only creation/modification times, 'Adobe After Effects 2026 (Macintosh)' and random document/instance UUIDs; no user name, e-mail, host name or other path remains. color_ae_curves.aep: the only host-specific content was the same footage alias fullpath (replaced as recorded); its XMP holds only times, the tool string and random document/instance UUIDs. color_ae_lumetri_custom_lut.aep: the only host-specific content was the authoring folder in the footage alias fullpath, in the Lumetri Blob LUT paths and <embeddedlut> file names, and in the UTF-16 path slots (all replaced as recorded); its XMP holds only times, the tool string and random document/instance UUIDs.
proof_status_note: Each case's proof_status records the state at authoring time. 'no converter comparison run' is superseded for the four effect cases (Lumetri, Color Balance, Channel Mixer, Selective Color) by the Adobe acceptance of converter exports recorded in docs/after-effects-support.md; Compositing Options and the Rec.2100 PQ project still have no converter comparison.
